description: This file defines the BearerTokenValidator class, which implements OAuth2 token validation logic within the OrangeHRM project. It checks for valid authorization headers, decrypts tokens, verifies their validity, expiration, and revocation status.

classes.name: BearerTokenValidator
classes.description: Class responsible for validating OAuth2 Bearer tokens in incoming HTTP requests. Implements token presence, decryption, existence, revocation, and expiration checks, returning the request with an attached access token on success.

methods.name: validateAuthorization
methods.description: Validates the OAuth2 Bearer token from incoming server request. Checks for Authorization header, decrypts token, verifies its validity, revocation status, and expiry, then attaches the token to the request.
